name: flutter_bloc
summary: Flutter widgets and integrations for the BLoC/Cubit state-management pattern, separating presentation from explicit business-logic state transitions.
advantages: Clear separation between UI and business logic
Predictable state flow and strong testing conventions
tradeoffs: Can introduce more ceremony than local or lightweight state solutions
Event/state modeling can be verbose when the problem is simple
recommendedFor: Teams that value explicit state-transition boundaries
Applications already standardized on BLoC or Cubit
Large teams that want a consistent state-transition convention

verification.reason: Current bloclibrary.dev guidance and pub.dev metadata are sufficient.
